data.baseline: per-trial mean subtraction from the fixed prestimulus interval
data.epoch_sample_grid: measured 128-Hz samples; predictions linearly sampled to each recording's grid

primary_model.route: signed contrast -> center-surround LGN ON/OFF -> Gabor -> common shape + rectified orientation opponents -> three Wilson-Cowan population pairs
primary_model.observation: fixed orthonormal u0/u1/u2 sensor coordinates mapped to F3/Fz/F4
primary_model.fit_scope: Stage1 left/right cue ERPs; leave-one-MAT-out; training records only
primary_model.output_units: relative model units; not calibrated microvolts

real_data_validation.classifier: real-only shrinkage LDA on 6 and 9 fixed trial features, leave-one-MAT-out
real_data_validation.interpretation: separability is not evidence by itself that the neural forward mechanism is correct

ablation_policy: legacy route and rank-2 output use primary fold parameters and signed amplitude without refitting
limitations: u modes are fixed sensor-space coordinates, not anatomical sources
no individualized head model or calibrated conductivity/volume conduction
only Stage1 left/right cues are fitted; unknown Stage2 layouts are not relabeled
P300 is not directly fitted or claimed
shared gain has no direct microvolt interpretation
